initiatives.name: Portfolio Reinvestment Programme Completion
initiatives.summary: Informa completed its reinvestment programme in 2024, having raised almost £2.5bn from 2022 divestments of B2B Intelligence portfolio businesses. The proceeds were reinvested into B2B Markets and Academic Markets businesses, including acquisitions of Tarsus, Winsight, HIMSS, Ascential, and Money20/20 brands.

evidence.title: Portfolio Reinvestment Programme Completion

The proceeds were reinvested into B2B Markets and Academic Markets businesses, including acquisitions of Tarsus, Winsight, HIMSS, Ascential, and Money20/20 brands.
evidence.quote: This programme completed in 2024 and has seen us reinvest the proceeds back into areas of our two major markets – B2B Markets and Academic Markets – that offer the greater growth potential. We raised almost £2.5bn from our 2022 divestments: a total that reflects the quality of our brands and teams, and strong interest from buyers.

initiatives.name: Ascential Acquisition and Integration
initiatives.summary: Informa completed the acquisition of Ascential plc for approximately £1.2bn, adding the globally recognised Cannes Lions Festival of Marketing and Money20/20 FinTech brand. This acquisition strengthens Informa's position in experience-led events and led to the creation of the Informa Festivals division.

initiatives.name: TechTarget Combination
initiatives.summary: Informa completed the combination of its Informa Tech digital businesses with TechTarget to create Informa TechTarget, where Informa holds the majority shareholding. This provides additional scale in content and data, broadens product range, and expands customer relationships in Enterprise Technology, particularly in the US market.

initiatives.name: Taylor & Francis AI Content Partnerships

initiatives.name: Sustainable Event Fundamentals Programme Expansion

evidence.title: Organisational Structure Update for 2025
evidence.summary: Informa is updating its organisational structure in 2025, moving from four operating divisions to a new structure focused on B2B Markets, Academic Markets, and B2B Digital Services.
